title: recovery's proofs reach the system temp directory only through the scratch door
intention: Every proof in cairn/devices/recovery takes its temp directory from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir, so nothing a recovery proof makes outlives its run, and recovery proves that of its own proofs.
why: Measured 2026-11-23 on akiendelllinux: bare_temp_reach over the repo named cairn/devices/recovery/proofs/test_recovery_s_floor_runs_from_python.py:71 (root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="floor-proof-"))), landed under 8610b4aa2477 (ffe36772f, 2026-11-23), so cairn/tools/scratch/proofs/test_scratch.py::test_no_proof_in_this_repo_calls_mkdtemp_bare and test_scratch_is_a_tool.py read red (red tickets 0746da231128, a30a49e8631f).
traces_to: Law 4 (the scratch door is physics, and this line steps around it) and CP6 (what a proof leaves in /tmp accumulates unseen; 3581 dirs did once).
how: In cairn/devices/recovery/proofs/test_recovery_s_floor_runs_from_python.py:71: root = Path(scratch_dir("floor-proof-")), scratch_dir imported from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch after the sys.path insert, and tempfile leaves the imports; the finally block's rmtree stays. the red-first proof cairn/devices/recovery/proofs/test_recoverys_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py, PROVES f5859eae9e08 key '1' on one tooth test_no_proof_in_recovery_reaches_temp_bare, calls cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.bare_temp_reach over cairn/devices/recovery and asserts it names nothing, in the shape of cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_base_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py. Proofs-only build. Prepared on akienasus/mkdtemp-scratch-door.

clauses.claim: bare_temp_reach over cairn/devices/recovery names no line, so no recovery proof reaches the system temp directory except through scratch_dir
